summary: The trace confirms the existing economic-time-series-correlation skill covers the core workflow well. The agent's HP filter return-order mistake validates the existing anti-pattern guidance. I'm adding two reusable patterns observed in this task: (1) catalog/mapping CSV files that map series names to column codes and deflator columns, and (2) the `version` field pattern (revised/prelim) as an alternative to `release_status`. I also add a quick self-verification tip for HP filter return order.
